entities.name: Phosphatidylserine decarboxylase
observations: The 298-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q7VQP8 from Blochmanniella floridana.
Curated function: catalyzes formation of phosphatidylethanolamine from phosphatidylserine.
The proenzyme autocleaves near residue 263 to generate a large beta chain and a small pyruvoyl-containing alpha chain.
Predicted domains: N-terminal PSD domain PF27523 and PS_Dcarbxylase domain PF02666.

entities.name: Phosphatidylserine decarboxylation
observations: The reaction is a decarboxylation in phosphatidylethanolamine biosynthesis.

entities.name: Pyruvoyl cofactor
observations: The enzyme binds one covalently attached pyruvoyl group per subunit, generated by autocatalytic cleavage of a serine residue.

entities.name: Cell membrane
observations: Curated localization is the cell membrane, where the enzyme is peripheral membrane-associated.
